member.name: T:Croupier.Sdk.Threading.MainThreadDispatcher
member.summary:
Main thread dispatcher - ensures callbacks execute on the main thread.
Usage: 1. Call Initialize() once on the main thread at startup 2. Call ProcessQueue() in your main loop (e.g., Unity's Update method) 3. Use Enqueue() from any thread to schedule callbacks
For Unity: - Add CroupierUnityBehaviour to a GameObject, or - Call MainThreadDispatcher.Instance.ProcessQueue() in your own Update method
